NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow NURI to use the camera to take a photo you choose to add to a conversation.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NURI uses the microphone to turn audio you actively record into text.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow NURI to access photos you choose to add to a conversation or save from the app.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow NURI to save images you explicitly choose to share to your photo library.
NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Allow Nuri to use Face ID to protect access to your saved sign-in credentials.
